# Model card: Computer Vision Quality Inspection System

**Scope:** portfolio research on synthetic data, not production.

**Model / baseline:** Image features, Logistic Regression vs Random Forest, precision and recall.

**Evaluation:** output generated by `python engine.py train` in `artifacts/metrics.json`.

**Known limitations:** Synthetic texture feature classifier only. Upgrade to real licensed MVTec/production images and a CNN with batch-level splits plus defect localization; benchmark after acquiring data.

**Intended audience:** engineering demonstration, interview portfolio, local experimentation.

**Out-of-scope:** real-time operational decisions and protected personal information.
